top_signals.title: Aramco’s New Chinese JV Refinery Gets First Saudi Crude Cargo
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco’s newest joint venture refinery in China has received its first cargo of Arab crude as it prepares for start-up, the Saudi oil giant said in a statement to Bloomberg on Wednesday, without providing a timeline for the start of commercial operations. Saudi Arabia and its state-owned oil giant early this decade embarked on a strategy to set up joint ventures with local Chinese partners to build refineries that would process Arab crude grades, to secure deliveries in China in the long term. top_signals.summary: ¿Por qué ha sido tan difícil derrotar a los hutíes en Yemen? El territorio, la diversificación de sus suministros y su creciente capacidad militar ayudan a entender cómo han resistido años de ofensivas y bombardeos. (Source: Bloomberg)
